external_id.description: Unique id of the call from the dialer system like hubspot, twilio, zoom, etc.

to.description: Phone number to which call was made (e.g., +12234567890)

participants.description: List of participants in the call. First entry should be the prospect/lead.

to_name.description: Name of the person to whom call was made

is_voicemail.description: Indicates if the call is a voicemail

additional_details.description: Additional details of the call (JSON object as string)

aiMetadata.description: Imports an external dialer call (Zoom, Twilio, Aircall, HubSpot, etc.) into Avoma for AI recording, transcription, and analysis. Use when ingesting call data captured outside Avoma; requires a publicly accessible recording URL, an Avoma user email, and a unique external_id. Not idempotent — each call creates a new record, and reposting the same external_id and source will fail as a duplicate.

get_meeting_recording.name: get_meeting_recording
get_meeting_recording.description: Returns video and audio recording URLs for a given meeting

auth.description: Your Avoma API Key (Bearer token). Generate it from your Avoma API Integration settings: https://help.avoma.com/api-integration-for-avoma

meeting_uuid.description: Select a meeting from your Avoma account

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the audio and video recording URLs for a single Avoma meeting by its meeting UUID. Use to obtain downloadable media links for a recorded meeting; the returned URLs are time-limited (expire in ~5 days) and the recording may still be processing (not yet available). Read-only and idempotent.

get_meeting_transcription.name: get_meeting_transcription
get_meeting_transcription.description: Returns transcription with speakers, timestamps, and VTT file URL

auth.description: Your Avoma API Key (Bearer token). Generate it from your Avoma API Integration settings: https://help.avoma.com/api-integration-for-avoma

transcription_uuid.description: Select a transcription from your Avoma meetings

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the transcription for a single Avoma meeting by its transcription UUID, including speaker-labeled segments and a downloadable VTT subtitle URL. Use to retrieve the text of a recorded meeting or call. Read-only and idempotent.

new_note.name: new_note
new_note.description: Triggers when notes are successfully generated for meetings or calls

setupInstructions.description:
**Quick Setup:**

1. In Avoma: **Settings > Integrations > Webhooks**
2. **Webhook URL:** `{{webhookUrl}}`
3. **Event Type:** Select **"AINOTE"**
4. **HTTP Method:** POST
5. **Content Type:** application/json

**Note:** Requires admin permissions in Avoma.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Avoma finishes generating AI notes for a recorded meeting or call (the AINOTE event), delivering the summary, action items, transcript and recording references for that conversation. Requires configuring the AINOTE webhook in Avoma settings.
